optimizedDescription.value: Scoped lazy CompositionResolver turns SpecdConfig+options into shared deps for config-based createX factories and kernel.

optimizedContext.value:
# CompositionResolver

## Rules
- Created from one `SpecdConfig` + options; one composition session only — NOT process singleton; NOT reuse across unrelated inputs.
- Exposes normalized shared deps (repos, schema services, actor, VCS, hooks, parsers, etc.) independent of fs-shaped factory inputs.
- Registry/merged-view/built-in-capability primitives = composition infrastructure, NOT kernel-owned.
- For `ChangeRepository`, assemble nested drafts/discarded options from separate YAML configs → unified options → storage factory.
- Lazy resolve; MUST NOT eager full-kernel graph for one standalone factory. MAY cache within session.
- MUST NOT centralize every `XDeps` — per-UC helpers e.g. `resolveCreateChangeDeps(resolver)` near `createX`.
- Config form `createX(config, options?)`: (1) create resolver (2) assemble `XDeps` via helper (3) delegate `createX(deps)`.
- Canonical contract remains `createX(deps)` — resolver supports, does not replace.
- Invalid arg combos → shared `InvalidCompositionFactoryArgumentsError` identifying target factory/UC name.

## Constraints
- Composition infrastructure, not domain/application service.
- MAY reuse registry helpers shared with kernel/builder; those remain composition-owned.
- MUST NOT be mandatory third public call shape for every `createX`.
- MUST NOT require eager full-kernel construction for standalone factory.
